answer: Rooted Harvest Selection: each epoch, agents derive a seed from a public beacon no one can predict in advance, then hash it with their identity to assign membership into fixed-size cohorts. Only a cohort’s lowest hash earns a task slot, so mass identities yield little without brute-forcing every permutation ahead of time. An attacker pays a fresh registration and compute cost per identity, uncorrelated with advantage—an orchard of fakes mostly fails. New agents start in a small oasis of low-value tasks to prove liveness. Honest work is recorded as a pearl in the ledger,
